subject: Geografia
description_pt: Identificar as características das paisagens naturais e antrópicas (relevo, cobertura vegetal, rios etc.) no ambiente em que vive, bem como a ação humana na conservação ou degradação dessas áreas.

components.description_pt: Identificar características de paisagens naturais no ambiente local, incluindo relevo, vegetação e rios
components.description_en: Identify characteristics of natural landscapes in the local environment, including relief, vegetation, and rivers
components.cc_component_description: Identify locations on Earth where water is found including oceans, rivers, lakes, and ponds

components.description_pt: Identificar características de paisagens modificadas pelo ser humano no ambiente local
components.description_en: Identify characteristics of human-modified landscapes in the local environment
components.cc_component_description: Identify ways human activities negatively impact land, water, air, or living things in the local environment

components.description_pt: Analisar o papel da ação humana na conservação ou degradação de paisagens locais
components.description_en: Analyze the role of human action in the conservation or degradation of local landscapes
components.cc_component_description: Analyze data showing correlations between resource extraction rates and degradation of Earth's systems

cc_matches.description: Communicate solutions that will reduce the impact of humans on the land, water, air, and/or other living things in the local environment.
Water is found in the ocean, rivers, lakes, and ponds. Water exists as solid ice and in liquid form.
Construct an argument supported by evidence for how increases in human population and per-capita consumption of natural resources impact Earth's systems.
